# Navigation icons

Selected Lucide icons from tag `0.468.0`, vendored as an SVG symbol sprite.
Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0/icons
License: ISC; see LICENSE (including the Feather attribution).

The paths are unchanged; each SVG wrapper becomes a symbol. The shared `.rail-icon`
style supplies size, stroke, and theme color. Icons are served locally without a
JavaScript dependency or CDN. Static navigation uses `<use>` directly; dynamic
windows use `railIcon()` and the mode mapping in `navigation.js`.
